evals.prompt: Is it safe to approve this spender for my ERC-20 token?
evals.expected_output: Uses security_risk, asks for chain/token/owner/spender if missing, checks approval risk, avoids signing guidance until risk is resolved, and ends with a runtime evidence receipt.
assertions: Selects approval_risk for this intent and uses only its conditional fallback when required.
Does not tell the user to sign while risk is unresolved.
Includes receipt ids and any unavailable checks.

evals.prompt: Check whether this dApp URL and contract look phishing-related before I connect my wallet.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dApp/address/phishing checks, reports severity/evidence/remediation, and caveats missing provider data.
assertions: Includes phishing or dApp risk checks.
